_about: Where each waypoint's pin TIP sits on the kit's 04_ASSETS/fictional_floor_plan.png, read off the image by eye (about +/- 6 px) and normalised 0..1 (x / width, y / height, origin top-left). Ours, not the sponsor's: the kit does not give pixel positions. The image shows both floors side by side; `panel` is each floor's rectangle on it. These do NOT follow locations.csv x_coord/y_coord by any affine map (see GET /api/spot/locations -> plan.fit).
